name: aria-relay-panel
description: V3 Relay server: cover-site proxy relay (v1 WS / v2 devsync) + hidden user panel

envDocs.SITE_KEY: master user secret (32 hex) — REQUIRED in production, no safe default
envDocs.ADMIN_PASS: panel password at /<ADMIN_PATH> — REQUIRED, panel stays locked when empty
envDocs.CONFIG_KEY: 48-hex config-encryption key; MUST equal the key embedded in the Android app for mo:// codes to work
envDocs.DATABASE_URL: Postgres connection string (empty = NODB in-memory mode)
envDocs.WORKER_URL: public URL shown in generated user commands/codes
envDocs.V2_DISABLE: set 1 to disable the v2 devsync protocol
envDocs.V2_DEBUG: set 1 to enable per-chunk verbose logs
envDocs.V2_TEST_USER: secret of an in-memory test user for v2
